C1128.title: Illegal Live-Stream Traffic Inflation Case in Yinzhou, Ningbo
C1128.summary: In April 2024, CNR reported a live-stream traffic manipulation case in Ningbo, Zhejiang. Wang operated a device farm using about 4,600 phones and fake accounts to generate follows, likes, and comments for livestreams, earning nearly 3 million yuan within several months. A court convicted Wang of illegal business operations and imposed one year and three months in prison, suspended for one year and six months, plus a 50,000-yuan fine.
